lines.say: Companies want AI agents to buy things for them. But an agent with a company card is a liability.
lines.caption: Companies want AI agents to buy things for them. But an agent with a company card is a liability.

lines.say: Three things go wrong. The agent grabs a discount that drains cash weeks later. A vendor slips in a hidden fee, and a prompt can't stop it. And merchants block bots they can't identify.
lines.caption: Three things go wrong. The agent grabs a discount that drains cash weeks later. A vendor slips in a hidden fee, and a prompt can't stop it. And merchants block bots they can't identify.

lines.say: IntentGuard splits the job. Claude reads the contract. Plain code makes every money decision. And Airwallex card controls enforce them, at the bank.
lines.caption: IntentGuard splits the job. Claude reads the contract. Plain code makes every money decision. And Airwallex card controls enforce them, at the bank.

lines.say: Here it is, running live on the Airwallex sandbox. First, the rules. Never let cash fall below forty thousand dollars over the next eight weeks.
lines.caption: Here it is, running live on the Airwallex sandbox. First, the rules: never let cash fall below $40,000 over the next 8 weeks.

lines.say: This is the vendor's order form, a PDF from CloudScale. It offers two prices. Nine thousand six hundred dollars upfront for a year, or one thousand dollars a month. And in the fine print, clause four point five allows an onboarding fee of up to two hundred and fifty dollars.
lines.caption: This is the vendor's order form, a PDF from CloudScale. It offers two prices: $9,600 upfront for a year, or $1,000 a month. And in the fine print, clause 4.5 allows an onboarding fee of up to $250.

lines.say: I drop the PDF straight into IntentGuard.
lines.caption: I drop the PDF straight into IntentGuard.

lines.say: Claude reads the prices and the fine print. Then code checks every number against the document, and forecasts eight weeks of cash.
lines.caption: Claude reads the prices and the fine print. Then code checks every number against the document, and forecasts 8 weeks of cash.

lines.say: The yearly plan is twenty percent cheaper. But paying it upfront drops cash below the floor in week seven. So the agent picks monthly, and sets a reminder to revisit yearly once a customer payment lands.
lines.caption: The yearly plan is 20% cheaper. But paying it upfront drops cash below the floor in week 7. So the agent picks monthly, and sets a reminder to revisit yearly once a customer payment lands.

lines.say: And every figure Claude used is highlighted in the original contract, so nothing is invented. Including that onboarding fee clause.
lines.caption: And every figure Claude used is highlighted in the original contract, so nothing is invented. Including that onboarding fee clause.

lines.say: I approve one thousand dollars a month. That approval is signed, and locked to these exact terms.
lines.caption: I approve $1,000 a month. That approval is signed, and locked to these exact terms.

lines.say: Airwallex issues a virtual Visa card that can pay only that. One thousand dollars per charge. Software stores only. US dollars only.
lines.caption: Airwallex issues a virtual Visa card that can pay only that: $1,000 per charge, software stores only, US dollars only.

lines.say: Under the hood, that approval is an S H A two fifty-six fingerprint of the exact terms. And every request the agent sends to the vendor is signed with its Visa Trusted Agent Protocol key.
lines.caption: Under the hood, that approval is a SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact terms. And every request the agent sends to the vendor is signed with its Visa Trusted Agent Protocol key.

lines.say: Now, checkout. The agent proves who it is with Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol. And the vendor's billing system quietly adds the two hundred and fifty dollar fee.
lines.caption: Now, checkout. The agent proves who it is with Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol. And the vendor's billing system quietly adds the $250 fee.

lines.say: Blocked. Airwallex declines the charge at the bank. Limit exceeded. The agent sees it doesn't match what I approved, and freezes the card. The vendor tries the fee on its own, and that's declined too. No money moved.
lines.caption: Blocked. Airwallex declines the charge at the bank: limit exceeded. The agent sees it doesn't match what I approved, and freezes the card. The vendor tries the fee on its own, and that's declined too. No money moved.

lines.say: The agent even looks up the decline code in Airwallex's own documentation, and Claude writes the incident report.
lines.caption: The agent even looks up the decline code in Airwallex's own documentation, and Claude writes the incident report.

lines.say: I hold the vendor to the original price.
lines.caption: I hold the vendor to the original price.

lines.say: The agent checks the cart matches my approval, unfreezes the card, and pays exactly one thousand dollars. Zero unapproved spending, and the reserve stays safe.
lines.caption: The agent checks the cart matches my approval, unfreezes the card, and pays exactly $1,000. Zero unapproved spending, and the reserve stays safe.

lines.say: Claude writes the audit note, and the week eight check-in to revisit the yearly plan is already scheduled, with a calendar invite.
lines.caption: Claude writes the audit note, and the week 8 check-in to revisit the yearly plan is already scheduled, with a calendar invite.

lines.say: And if a payment ever needs undoing, the refund goes back through Airwallex, and the card's spending limit is restored.
lines.caption: And if a payment ever needs undoing, the refund goes back through Airwallex, and the card's spending limit is restored.

lines.say: And this isn't a mock-up. Here's the real Airwallex dashboard, for a card from an earlier run of this exact flow, with its one thousand dollar limits.
lines.caption: And this isn't a mock-up. Here's the real Airwallex dashboard, for a card from an earlier run of this exact flow, with its $1,000 limits.

lines.say: Airwallex recorded all four transactions.
lines.caption: Airwallex recorded all four transactions.

lines.say: The twelve hundred and fifty dollar charge. Declined. Card's spend limit exceeded.
lines.caption: The $1,250 charge: declined. Card's spend limit exceeded.

lines.say: The two hundred and fifty dollar retry. Declined. The card was frozen.
lines.caption: The $250 retry: declined. The card was frozen.

lines.say: The one thousand dollar payment. Settled.
lines.caption: The $1,000 payment: settled.

lines.say: And here's the refund, credited back. Plus one thousand dollars, marked refunded.
lines.caption: And here's the refund, credited back: +$1,000, marked refunded.

lines.say: And every step is real. Live Airwallex API calls, signed agent requests, and a full audit trail.
lines.caption: And every step is real: live Airwallex API calls, signed agent requests, and a full audit trail.

lines.say: Every step moves through a state machine in code. The quarantine is right there, and illegal jumps are simply rejected.
lines.caption: Every step moves through a state machine in code. The quarantine is right there, and illegal jumps are simply rejected.

lines.say: And this is the agent's identity. The public key merchants use to verify every signed request.
lines.caption: And this is the agent's identity: the public key merchants use to verify every signed request.

lines.say: Three layers of protection. The card limit stops overcharges, with no AI involved. The fingerprint check catches what limits can't. And a human always makes the final call.
lines.caption: Three layers of protection. The card limit stops overcharges, with no AI involved. The fingerprint check catches what limits can't. And a human always makes the final call.

lines.say: IntentGuard. Agents that spend exactly what you approved, and nothing more.
